title: Phased capacity orchestration and launch slate optimizer for runtime/console/API
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Launch weeks are high-risk for runtime/console/API changes because multiple teams compete for limited Dedicated/Hosted capacity and regional headrooms. Current manual slot allocation and ad-hoc surge hedging cause last-minute cutoffs and inconsistent stakeholder signals.

Goal: Build a Launch Slate Optimizer (LSO) service and runbook that automatically recommends and enforces phased capacity allocations across surfaces (runtime, console, API) and regions. The LSO should: 1) provide a simulated capacity plan given commit/feature metadata and historical traffic profiles; 2) reserve and release capacity slots with guardrails tied to capacity sentinel metrics; 3) surface conflicts and mitigation suggestions to PMs/ENG/Infra; 4) integrate with the launch calendar and Slack notifications so owners can accept or override recommendations.

Outcomes: reduce last-minute capacity collisions by 70%, reduce emergency rollbacks for launch capacity by 50%, and provide a single source of truth for cross-surface cutover windows.
acceptance_criteria: LSO prototype can ingest feature slot requests and produce a phased capacity plan (regional + surface) with clear confidence bands
Simulator shows expected latency/cost impact for proposed allocations compared to historical baseline (example dashboards)
Integration with launch calendar: reservations and conflicts are visible in the shared calendar and in the ticket card
Automatic guardrail triggers: if capacity sentinels (95th latency, queue depth, GPU saturation) cross thresholds, LSO suggests pre-approved fallbacks and notifies owners
Runbook outlining decision flow, rollback triggers, and oncall responsibilities is published and validated in an ops tabletop exercise
One pilot launch uses LSO recommendations end-to-end with no emergency capacity escalation
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): data collection and simulator spike using last 3 quarters of traffic; Phase 2 (3 weeks): slot reservation API, calendar integration, and Slack notifications; Phase 3 (2 sprints): guardrail rules and canary pilot with one runtime release and one console release; Phase 4: iterate on heuristics and add regional burst hedges plus 2 additional pilot launches.
